notes.title: Surprise Update: Now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
Hey Dreamscapers!

As many of you know, we have spent the last year hard at work on our second unannounced title thanks to your support of our studio. However, we fell in love with the Steam Deck over the holidays and felt strongly that Dreamscaper is the perfect game for the device.

Therefore, we are thrilled to announce that we have also been secretly revisiting Dreamscaper in order to improve the performance, usability and readability of our game specifically for the Steam Deck. That is correct: Dreamscaper is now officially a Verified Steam Deck game.

We hope that you enjoy this new update and please let us know if you encounter any new issues related to these changes so that we can hotfix them ASAP.

Love,
Rob, Ian & Paul

notes.title: Announcing the Dreamscaper 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hey Dreamers,

As a special thank you for all your post-launch support and feedback, we'll be releasing a major update to Dreamscaper next week, on [b]October 21st[/b].

We've been incorporating more of your suggestions into the game as we've been adding some brand new content.

Here's what you can expect:

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Merchant Rerolling[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/0d23e834180dfa203cc0c9eb62169b5b397e98bd.gif[/img]

A highly requested feature - players will now have the ability to spend Sand to refresh the options in the merchant room. This new feature can be unlocked via the Daydreaming system.

[h3]Metacurrency to Sand Converter[/h3]

To couple with Merchant Rerolling, players will now be able to convert excess waking world currency (like glass or resolve) into Sand from within each levels starting room. We hope this allows for more flexibility to create the build you want. This new feature can also be unlocked via the Daydreaming system.

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/b997169d9e21295d6eafc5c0f37b1290413e487e.gif[/img]

A whole slew of new items:
[list]
[b][*] Two melee attacks
[*] Two ranged attacks
[*] Four lucid attacks
[*] Eleven Keepsakes[/b]
[/list]
[h2]New Rooms[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/6d86842a62d6e45b400dd39df38f7302668bc4d8.gif[/img]

Paul has been hard at work on some gorgeous new rooms that will add variety to the earlier levels. Each of the rooms comes with new memories Cassidy can discover as well.

Finally, we've also added new Secret Room stylings in the later levels.

[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Icons display on the HUD for when an unused Firebird is active or when the double metacurrency buff is currently active (Before taking damage).
[*] Text on Off Balanced has clearer language
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blowgun, Biting Dagger & Fireburst have had damage reduced.
[*] Player can no longer be impacted by their own status effects on projectiles parried by enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where auto-skipping Regret's intro/outro caused the clock arm to disappear.
[*] Auto-recycling of Health Potions that are off-screen will correctly scale the sand with level now.
[*] Spawning Keepsakes through White Elephant will no longer produce possible duplicate Keepsakes.
[*] Astral Blow can now spawn in Random starting loadouts.
[*] Perfect Damage & Window modifiers no longer spawn on automatic ranged weapons.
[*] Umbrella's Alt Attack has been fixed
[*] Escape menu now correctly dismisses menus first in Dream instead of immediately bringing up the Escape menu.
[*] Fix bug where projectiles would collide with the visual AOE of the debuffing turret.
[*] Adjusted Whirling Currents alt attack to help prevent physics bugs, adjusted recovery time.
[*] Erroneous "burn duration" text on buffing items now correctly says "buff duration."
[*] Fixed many typos across all languages.
[/list]

This build is currently live on our "test" branch if you'd like to help us iron out the kinks.

To access the "test" beta you simply:
1. Right click Dreamscaper in Steam.
2. Select "Properties..."
3. Choose the "BETAS" tab.
4. Select "test" from the drop-down menu.

We greatly appreciate your continued support of Dreamscaper, as always, come [url=http://discord.gg/dreamscaper]hang with us[/url] in Discord or [url=http://twitter.com/dreamscapergame]follow us[/url] on Twitter.

Finally, if you haven't done so already, you can always help us out by leaving us a Steam review with your thoughts!

Thank you for playing!

- Afterburner Studios (Ian, Paul & Rob)

notes.title: Dreamscaper Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've been following your conversations in Discord and on the forums since launch and have compiled a list of the most-asked for changes and improvements. Over the last month, we've been implementing those requests and modifying Dreamscaper based on all your great feedback.

Today we're releasing our first major quality of life update, with your requested changes, ahead of our planned 1.1 update.

Here's what you can expect:

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Black Hole now damages enemies with an explosion at the end
[*] Bombs now have screen shake
[*] Overworld map lists what location takes what meta currency
[*] Checkbox to auto-skip boss cutscenes is now in the options menu
[*] New iconography that indicates whether a modifier is global or for that item
[*] Checkbox for higher visibility cursor (M+K)
[*] Clearer indication item is mastered in loadout list
[*] Left side of loadout menu now shows mastery level
[*] Auto-recycle now works on sand
[*] Nightmare Loss electrical hazard uses green color instead of blue
[*] Wanderer buffing effects have more clear visual indicator
[*] Re-rolling chit chat interest once if initial roll is a duplicate.
[*] Puzzle of Revelation no longer has guess work, there is always a deterministic answer
[*] Traps are now deactivated in cleared rooms
[*] No longer duplicates in choice rooms and merchant shops
[*] Item UI displays total damage calculation for multi-hit attacks
[*] Random Mastered / Random Not Mastered are now options in the loadout list
[*] Firebird feather now staggers enemies when triggered
[*] The player can no longer be grabbed out of long hit reactions by the bruiser
[*] Shock now applies over time and can be applied as first element that causes a Critical Extinguish
[*] Healing numbers pop up over the player similar to damage
[*] Sub 1 damage and healing numbers now display a decimal point (e.g. 0.4)
[*] Lucid attack icons on the HUD display remaining cooldown seconds
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Resentment now has a new attack and a more challenging attack pattern
[*] Regret has received a difficulty increase, and a slight health decrease
[*] Dream Intensity rewards have been increased substantially
[*] Overall meta-progression speed has been increased to reduce grind
[*] Critical Extinguishes can only be triggered by attacks, not statuses
[*] Critical Extinguishes can only be triggered by separate attacks
[*] Mastering an item now immediately grants a small amount of meta currency
[*] Sand grants now scale with level
[*] Deflector shield boost to parry window now 100%
[*] Crystal Barrier recharge from 15 to 20 seconds
[*] Reduced Loss speed at higher intensities and second phase
[*] Mage's pillar attack is less punishing and easier to avoid
[*] Reduce duration of Player popup and stagger hit reacts
[*] Spirit board hitbox size increased
[*] Finger Gun's Mastery Modifier changed to lucid consumption decrease
[*] Adjusted height of water balloon and firecracker projectile
[*] Decent Drencher and Boostie Fuego now always apply status effects
[*] Boostie Fuego's range and damage increased
[*] Shock chain length & damage increased
[*] Poison damage mastery modifier is now +10% damage
[*] Spring Feet keepsake now grants +30% Max Health
[*] Doubling Booster shot health recovery to +20%
[*] Decreased strength of Wanderer buffs
[*] Parried enemies are staggered for 25% longer
[*] Modifier that triggers healing with a successful parry has been buffed
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs with leech effect not applying
[*] Fixed bug where beam weapons weren't applying leech consistently
[*] Fixed camera-framing bug during Loss fight
[*] Explosive Trap Resistance now works on Assassin's bombs, late stage elemental explosive traps and ring explosive traps
[*] Fixed bug where fire resistance wasn't applying to certain enemy attacks
[*] Overdrive no longer lists a level / is not affected by item level
[*] Various bug fixes for end-of-level auto-recycle
[*] Fixed issue where projectiles and attacks did not destroy the Assassin's mines
[*] Fix cooldown trigger on a variety of lucid attacks
[*] Fixing bug where unreleased items were counted in % completion.
[*] Various fixes to geometry and collision so players can not fall out of bounds
[*] Various fixes to geometry and collision so enemies can not teleport out of bounds
[*] Various fixes to rooms so enemies and treasure do not spawn out of bounds
[*] Fixed typos across all languages
[*] Fixed visual bug in the Enchantment Room in The Return
[*] Can no longer walk up table/couch in Apartment (sorry)
[*] Fixing bug where the player can be damaged by "frozen" attack collision.
[*] Fixing bug where ability projectiles weren't getting damage buff.
[*] Medicine Ball Keepsake now affects speed for ranged lucid attacks
[*] Fixed bug where Enchantment Room UI would resize on selection.
[*] Fixed looping teleport bug on Assassin
[/list]

Thanks again for your amazing feedback and your continued dedication to improving Dreamscaper with us! We look forward to hearing more from all of you.

As always, if you haven't yet, please leave us a review with your thoughts.

You can also give us feedback directly [url=http://discord.gg/dreamscaper]via Discord[/url].

Next up we have new content in our 1.1 update! We'll be sharing more with you in the coming months.

- Ian, Rob & Paul

notes.title: 1.0 QoL & Stability Patch #3 (1.0.4.1)
notes.notes:
Our original plan was to hold off on releasing another patch until our larger Quality-of-Life update was ready. However, the list of what we want to do is so long that it will take at least a couple of weeks to complete. Therefore we picked a few of the most popular QoL improvements, resolved all of the (known) crashes in our game, and bundled them together this week.

QoL Improvements:
[list]
[*] By popular demand, players can now choose to opt out of the Discord prompt that appears when exiting the game.
[*] Saves are now backed up at the start of every floor so runs can now be salvaged in the event of a crash or hardware failure.
[*] While still not officially supported, ultrawide aspect ratios no longer cut the bottom or top of the play area in dreams.
[/list]
Crash Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for the crashes that could occur on the 6th floor when traveling between rooms.
[*] Fix for the crash that can occur between floors when swapping Influences.
[*] Fix for the crashes that were occurring in the 3rd boss fight.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed soft-locks and other weird issues caused by bosses and players dying within moments of each other.
[*] Fixed out-of-bound enemies spawning in the 6th floor.
[/list]
Hopefully this will tide you over until our larger QoL update that should arrive in the next couple of weeks. Of course if new critical issues or regressions arise, we will continue to release smaller hotfixes to keep everything stable.

Cheers,
Rob, Ian & Paul

This is why we do early access! Thank you to everyone who caught this. I'm glad we had it sorted before our 1.0 launch.

- Rob

notes.title: Catnap Update #2
notes.notes:
As we mentioned in our last update, virtually all of our energy is focused on our upcoming Dreamscaper 1.0 release. In the meantime, [b]we've made a huge number of (mostly user-suggested) improvements to the game[/b] that we feel comfortable releasing into Early Access in the form of our [b]second Catnap Update[/b].

[h1]Quality-of-life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Lucid Fountains now grant a random Lucid Drop Keepsake (+% Max Lucid)
[*]Character Stats in the Inventory are only displayed for stats that have been modified from the default.
[*]Daydreaming & Meditation no longer have explicit upgrade tiers to purchase. Tiers are unlocked simply through total currency spend.
[*]Crystal Barrier will stagger nearby enemies when broken.
[*]The Sketchbook has an exclamation mark next to discovered Ideas that haven't been viewed yet.
[*]When discovering a new preferred gift, fanfare animation & sound is triggered.
[*]Items that double keys and/or bombs will give you 1 of the currency if you have 0 before pickup.
[*]Perfect Dodges additionally buff the interrupting Melee & Ranged Weapon attack damage as well.
[*]Explicit Shatter has been replaced with Frozen enemies being shattered by natural critical hits (more common synergy).
[*]Camera Zoom settings can now be set in the Controls options (Toggle, 1x, 2x, 4x).
[*]Lobbed Player Projectiles have a consistent arc now, regardless of speed.
[*]"Chained Effects" have been renamed to "Shock Chain" to reduce confusion over the feature.
[*]Level Summary UI has received some polish.
[*]Save slots now display "Nights Passed" and "Successful Runs"
[*]The projectile-firing traps should now have better positioning outside of the level bounds, so that their collision does not impede the player.
[*]The attack telegraphs appearing over the player's head have been given a stroke, made larger and more obvious.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Level generation has been improved so that certain room types are statistically more common. For example, Enchantment room should now show up in approximately half of all floors.
[*]Taking non-parried hits to your shield drains Lucid (not very much).
[*]The Meditation upgrade "Celebrate My Success" has been moved to an earlier tier.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixing bug where fast-moving projectiles could skip past enemies.
[*] Fixing bug where lobbed enemy projectiles could "hang" in the air.
[*] Fixing bugs with controller force feedback.
[*] Fixing bug with Treasure Map.
[*] Fixing bug with Futuresight upgrade.
[*] Fixing bugs where Character Stats could display 0 health.
[*] Fixing bug where Nightmare Campground could receive repeating rooms.
[*] Fixing bug where City was more likely to spawn specific rooms.
[*] Fixing bug where enemies could rotate in a jerky fashion.
[*] Fixing bug where some status effects could deal 0 damage.
[*] Fixing camera issue for Negativty fight.
[*] Numerous boss fixes.
[*] Numerous enemy fixes.
[*] Numerous level collision fixes.
[*] Numerous UI fixes.
[*] Numerous loot spawn location fixes.
[*] Numerous typo fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Closing Thoughts[/h1]

This will likely be our last feature update before our 1.0 release. We will continue to patch bugs, but everything else we'd like to save for our full launch to make that moment as special as possible.

Thank you to all of you for helping to support Dreamscaper's development throughout Early Access. It literally would not have been possible without you. We know that many of you understandably have questions around the 1.0 release date, and while we can tell you that we've already made tremendous progress towards that milestone, we are unable to reveal a specific date at this time. We appreciate your patience and have been working hard to make it worth the wait!

If you encounter bugs or have additional feedback for this update, drop us a line here or over on [url=http://discord.gg/dreamscaper]Discord[/url].

Cheers,

- Rob, Ian & Paul

notes.title: Catnap Update #1
notes.notes:
As we enter the final stretch of Dreamscaper's Early Access period, we are now focusing most of our efforts on delivering the best Dreamscaper 1.0 experience possible. The team is well on their way towards finishing the final biome, the two final bosses and fleshing out a more complete story for Cassidy.

While this work admittedly stretches our 3-person team fairly thin, we decided we still wanted to continue providing regular updates to those of you who continue to support our game's development. [b]Today we kick-off the "Catnap" series of updates which focus primarily on quality-of-life improvements & gameplay refinements based directly on your feedback.[/b]

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h2]Dodge Improvements[/h2]

While we put a lot of time towards improving combat throughout Early Access, one area in particular that didn't get a lot of our attention was dodging. As players, you pointed out that not all dodges are created equal, and the ones with longer recovery time were particularly polarizing. Introducing the [b]"Perfect Dodge Interrupt"[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/72e9a7ac170d91c140aaaea0c0fc8c1179578c61.gif[/img]

Originally suggested by Discord user "JT", we applied the same "Perfect" system we have for Melee & Ranged attacks to the recovery animations of each dodge. As you can see, even the dodges with the highest recovery become far more deadly once perfected. 

[h2]Guard Break[/h2]

We have heard your feedback that shielded enemies can break the flow of combat. Our original intent here was to introduce enemies that virtually required parrying, but as we added enemies with more nuanced hitstun rules, we believe this is no longer a necessity. [b]Therefore, we've added the concept of "Guard Break" into our game[/b] (thank you "PiRoScOuT", "DaddyDeGrand" et al for the suggestion):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/09a65a8d005dedef4444133cd5ec58654f4999ef.gif[/img]

For now, all Alternate Attack on all Melee Weapons will break guard. We will continue to refine and expand on this system as we receive additional feedback.

[h2]New Secret Room Visuals[/h2]

We have polished up our secret rooms by giving them a very distinct aesthetic. Thanks to Paul's gorgeous environments, they now truly feel like they're real secrets worth discovering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/e5c3d379e19061dc9439b8deed968a1e59d5bbfb.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Exchange Room Visuals[/h2]

Similarly, Paul gave the exchange rooms a distinct aesthetic as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/4c73d12500be1c8a4a81686e5042b73728589046.jpg[/img]

[h2]Minimap Improvements[/h2]

Discord user "Hashin" pointed out that there was no way to tell the difference between a portal that is Locked, Reinforced, or a combination of the two. For now, we have decided to simply [b]color-code the portal in the UI[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/e9ab31e48bdc8a9d81e7fc11f2ee54dd0eb872fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Destructibles 2.0[/h2]

There are admittedly quite a few issues with destructibles. We've reworked the mechanic from the ground up to solve all of the observed frustrations:

[h3]Destruction[/h3]

Have you had times where it's taken way too long trying to fully destroy a cluster? What about one or two small stragglers getting completely lost? [b]We are now far more generous with hits and we've introduced rules that prevent stragglers completely.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/b77bea8c9645bb629824e7abbb8041b9f88a5e7f.gif[/img]

[h3]Bomb Rules[/h3]

Originally we wanted players to be deliberate in where they place bombs for clearing reinforced destructibles. Over time, it became clear that it was frustrating to not fully destroy a cluster with a bomb. Fortunately, we also discovered that it's far more fun to be deliberate when placing bombs relative to multiple clusters, portals or enemies. Therefore, we've changed it so that bombs [b]fully destroy a destructible cluster[/b] in order to encourage more experimentation with bombs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/08ca4309ddd28e45e5ff4e717f69772a16f700ef.gif[/img]

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unclaimed items on the ground will be automatically recycled into sand on descension!
[*] You can now recycle item choices without having to pick one up first.

notes.title: Rise and Shine with the Awakening Update
notes.notes:
After some fantastic help from everyone on discord testing the Awakening Update, it's now live! 

[b]This updates is all about making Dreamscaper a more rewarding game to keep coming back to.[/b] We focused heavily on game flow and meta-progression, expanding the Waking World to have more depth and gameplay than before.

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h3]Brand New Game Flow[/h3]

As we mentioned in the previous update, your feedback on pacing and game flow helped inform this new direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/80a0ce106fb4f89384be291603c19ccd79010b9d.gif[/img]

[b]Cassidy no longer wakes up between dreams[/b]. Instead, your dream is one continuous experience. 
We have more we will be expanding on with game flow in our coming updates. Without giving too much away, we'll be working to make sure there are more discreet milestones that help fill out Cassidy's story.

As for the waking world - we've done away with the concept of "time" as energy to be used. The [b]waking world is much more freeform with lots of new things to do.[/b]

[h2]Meta Progression[/h2]

In our tease, we mentioned that:

[quote]We've spent a lot of our time this update introducing layered progression systems that will [b]alter the Dreamscape, increase Cassidy's strength, provide fun goals and drastically flesh out the Waking World[/b].[/quote]

Let's dive a little deeper into what those systems are:

[h3]Meditation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/4941143812fdc91ba30447405c5e212b02359b75.jpg[/img]

Cassidy can travel to Taylor Park to Meditate. Meditation allows Cassidy to focus and work on herself, [b]permanently improving stats and granting new abilities[/b] to be used in the Dreamscapes.

[h3]Daydreaming[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/478f48cd7ea3150547505e9e4357e660d7cc9f4e.jpg[/img]

At the bar, Cassidy can get lost in thought. While Daydreaming, Cassidy can upgrade the Dreamscape, [b]unlocking new types of rooms and enhancing the dream world.[/b]

[h3]Sketching[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/77475a6c7b8529658cb1029e63980385e15b8196.jpg[/img]

At the Cafe, Cassidy can sketch out new ideas she finds in her dreams. While in the Dreamscape, you will come across Ideas for items that Cassidy will take back to the Waking World with her. Cassidy can [b]spend Sparks of inspiration to flesh these ideas out and unlock new items & abilities[/b] for her next trip into her dreams.

[h3]To-Do List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/af13ea82468fe2698b44cd1f73207ed81a892214.jpg[/img]

Cassidy has begun to keep a To-Do List in her dream journal. There she can [b]track her progress with various quests and reap rewards for completing them.[/b]

[h3]Item Mastery[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/cbec911ee920af5f92057d0cddb511c65f53e275.jpg[/img]

All equipment now has a Mastery component. [b]Mastering an item will unlock a permanent additive modifier for that item.[/b]

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/0beb33fae29f9a7cf16110e6bf3e274dc9fd124d.jpg[/img]

Crafting has been stripped down and received a major facelift. This simplified system has been given some added depth with Recipes. As Cassidy travels throughout Redhaven, she can find crafting recipes that will unlock more elaborate gifts to give to her friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/9bbe76adceb64be178798093e90ce3c253e3b6f0.jpg[/img]


[h3]Updated UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/8e347e6d8c47db0421857a4c4406e27ae2fcbc05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34691751/d364b2e74dc0c7fe2de05fa91f92d400f71d888e.jpg[/img]

New rooms have been added to this update to help flesh out the Nightmare Campground. Expect some new visuals and modified enemy configurations.

[h3]Closing Thoughts[/h3]

As always, you can expect a slew of bug and crash fixes with this update as well.

notes.title: Engine Upgrade + Stability Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As many of you know, Dreamscaper is built on Unreal Engine 4. More specifically, we started building our game on UE4.21 two years ago. Since then, Epic Games has made numerous improvements and fixed countless bugs / crashes and, earlier this year, they released UE4.25.

Normally once a game has been released into the wild, game developers won't take on the risk or the workload involved with upgrading engines. Two years of engine updates amounts to thousands of file changes and hundreds of thousands of line changes. You'd have to be crazy to try to upgrade that many engine versions.

So naturally we decided to upgrade directly to UE4.25 within the first month of our Early Access launch. Now, why would do that?

[olist]
[*] We love our players and want to get you the most up-to-date crash/bug fixes.
[*] It lays the groundwork for future console ports.
[*] We're hoping Early Access gives us some leeway when it comes to regressions.
[*] Rob is very stubborn and was convinced he could pull it off. ;)
[/olist]

Thanks to the help of some incredible Dreamscapers in our Discord Server, we've spent the last week testing this new engine upgrade and today we've released it to all of you. While this update isn't as "sexy" as our content updates, there are some very important fixes and improvements:

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Numerous GPU compatibility crashes should be fixed (D3D Device Lost).
[*] Numerous PhysX crashes should be fixed.
[*] Numerous miscellaneous engine fixes (e.g. drop down list bug w/ gamepads etc.)
[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 years worth of optimizations by Epic Games
[*] 25% reduction in file size on disk.
[*] Logic to prevent Cassidy from getting stuck in geometry.
[*] Logic to allow Cassidy to dodge out of corners when being mobbed.
[*] Better support for future console ports.
[/list]

Now, it's very likely that there will be some regressions from this upgrade. This means that new bugs will pop up that didn't exist before because those engine changes that we were relying on get moved around and create unintended consequences. Hopefully these are all just minor visual issues, but be sure to let us know when you find one and we'll be sure to fix them up by our next big content update at the latest.

A huge thanks to the following Discord users who already caught and helped us fix numerous regressions over the past two weeks: Shadow Sorcerer, notop, UnseenOak, Grimicus, Exvaris, FinW, jimminy, Goldy, Totes & JonJonLovesFood. We will always have those bloomed out Disco Nightmare memories. <3

Thanks again to everyone for helping us continue to improve Dreamscaper. [b]If you haven't yet, please leave a review, it's very appreciated![/b]

- Rob, Paul & Ian

notes.title: Major QoL Patch + New Lucid Attack!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Very excited to share our first major post-launch patch!

We spent the last week gathering your feedback and making improvements to Dreamscaper, here's what you can expect from today's patch:

[h1]NEW LUCID ATTACK[/h1]

[h3]BREAKING[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ErgGX4U.gif[/img]

How else could we celebrate the launch of Dreamscaper into Early Access than with some sweet dance moves from Cassidy?

[h1]PATCH NOTES v. 0.10.14[/h1]

[i]You may need to reset steam to trigger the update to the right version.[/i]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

Health of enemies on the first two levels has been reduced. - [i]thanks TheLastoftheRomans![/i]
Thunder Step triggers much quicker, but has reduced damage.
Modified difficulty of Minibosses on Campground Pt 2 and Nightmare City Pt 1.
Decreased enemy spawns in certain Nightmare City rooms.
Decreased Spear enemy's leaping attack frequency.
Decreased Ranged enemy's instant laser attack frequency.
Bottle Rocket has faster recovery.
Black Hole now applies status modifiers to enemies caught in its pull.
Cooldown on Kilonova has increased.
Cooldown on Rain of Blades has increased.
Cooldown on Frost Fracture has increased.
Cooldown on Skyfall has increased.
Fear has slightly lowered health.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

Isolation (Campground Pt. 1 Boss) has new moves that make the fight more challenging and dynamic.
Unlocks can now be toggled off in the dream journal so they no longer spawn. - [i]thanks SniperFox47![/i]
Red pits now have a short window before damaging players that allows for more forgiving dodges. - [i]thanks UnseenOak![/i]
Lucid attacks now have a "cooldown ready" sound. - [i]thanks HolyForce![/i]
Items now display what class they belong to when interacting with them.  - [i]thanks Sup3rN3rd![/i]
Bosses are no longer resistant to status effects, with the exception of freeze. - [i]thanks UnseenOak![/i]
Tile puzzle has clearer visuals.
Many lucid attacks now have a more forgiving cooldown trigger window. - [i]thanks Xii Alpha iiiXx![/i]
Bosses drop rewards further from Ascension Stones to prevent accidental ascensions.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Numerous crash fixes, stability should be much higher overall.
Numerous fixes for hitching.
Crystal Barrier no longer spawns with parry window modifier.
Boss attacks now disappear when bosses are defeated.
Fast Travel now works to and from visited Boss rooms.
Fixed issue where sometimes Previous Inventory spawned in next run.
Resources Tab in Crafting Menu is now populated correctly.
Waking World collision fixes.
Nightmare City occlusion, movement and collision fixes.
Fixed hit react and audio bug with Stalwart Shield.
Fixed visual bug when using two Coldsnaps in a row.
Fixed visual bug where Cassidy blends up onto the bar stool when talking to Eve. - [i]thanks VraelTheRider![/i]
Tutorial turret has firing sound now.
Fixed visual bug with Isolation's blackout ability.
Added missing VFX to Loss intro and outro sequence.
Fixed numerous typos across the memory system.
Fixed numerous typos across items.
Fixed numerous typos across dialogue sequences.
You can no longer parry Red Pits. Sorry.

[h1]FUTURE PLANS[/h1]

We'll have more news about our first major update shortly, we'll be breaking down what content we plan to add and what the timeline looks like.

Today, we'll be streaming Dreamscaper on Twitch and answering your questions. Join us at 5PM EST / 2PM PST:

https://www.twitch.tv/dreamscapergame

Thank you all for playing Dreamscaper and spreading the word.

If you've had a chance to play, please leave a review, we'd love to hear your feedback!

We are 100% committed to making Dreamscaper a better game with your help and really do appreciate your early support.


- Ian, Rob & Paul
